request.what: Fund a Year-2 contracted cost and a 12-month enhancement and maintenance program for critical integrations delivered under CCI V1 (Circle USDCx, LayerZero, Pyth, Dune), plus a new native Fireblocks integration
request.recipient: The Cardano Critical Integrations team / partners
deliverables: 12 months operations and maintenance of CCI V1 integrations
Contracted Year-2 licensing/platform fees for Circle, LayerZero, Pyth, Dune

claims.claim: CCI V1 integrations (Circle, LayerZero, Pyth, Dune) require ongoing annual licensing/service payments to remain operational
Without maintenance funding the previously delivered integrations risk degradation or going offline
The program creates a recurring annual treasury dependency for third-party infrastructure
A new full native Fireblocks integration is included alongside maintenance of existing ones

summary: A 23M ADA request to pay Year-2 licensing and 12 months of maintenance for the Circle/LayerZero/Pyth/Dune integrations and to add Fireblocks — a recurring treasury dependency.
